quarterly_data.quarter: JX Advanced Metals press release: Further Expansion of Production Capacity for Magnetic (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hard disk media targets: JX Advanced Metals decided to further expand production capacity for magnetic sputtering targets used in hard disk media (HD media) for HDDs, following the investment announced on June 11, 2026 (a plan to expand capacity gradually beginning in the second half of fiscal 2026). Through continuous capacity expansion over the next three years, including the previously announced increase, it will raise production capacity to 1.5 times the 2025 level by mid-2029. The company cites HDD demand expected to keep growing over the medium to long term as generative AI and cloud services accelerate data-center data volumes, and the shift in HDD recording from PMR to HAMR bringing new materials into HD media.
quarterly_data.figure: production capacity 1.5 times the 2025 level by mid-2029
